item.title: R-Day: LG to take salute, CM to attend as chief Guest
item.description: Jammu: Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha will preside over and take the salute at the main Republic Day function to be held at Maulana Azad Stadium, Jammu, on January 26, as Jammu and Kashmir steps up preparations for the national celebrations amid heightened security across the Union Territory. Chief Minister Omar Abdullah will attend the main function as the chief guest, while senior ministers have been assigned to preside over Republic Day events at key district headquarters. item.title: SOG detains Sidhra resident over suspected cross-border contact
item.description: SUMIT SHARMA Jammu: In a significant security-related development, a team of the Special Operations Group (SOG), Jammu, on Thursday morning detained a resident of Sidhra for questioning in connection with suspected communication links across the border. Official sources said the SOG team reached the Sidhra area today morning and took one Muhammad Afzal into custody for further verification. item.title: Ladakh Freezes at –9.9°C as Sub-Zero Cold grips Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: Ladakh continued to reel under extreme cold conditions, emerging as the coldest region, while the Kashmir Valley recorded widespread sub-zero temperatures and the Jammu region experienced comparatively milder winter conditions. According to data compiled by Kashmir Weather, Drass recorded the lowest minimum temperature at minus 9.9 degrees Celsius. item.title: Shab-e-Meraj celebrated across Kashmir valley
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: Shab-e-Meraj was observed across the Kashmir Valley on Friday night, with night-long prayers held in mosques and shrines despite the ongoing Chillai–Kalan, the 40-day period of the harshest winter in the region. Devotees gathered at various places of worship to offer special prayers seeking peace, prosperity, and forgiveness. item.title: Jammu–Srinagar Highway reopens for Two-Way Traffic amid heavy rush
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway is open for two-way traffic on Saturday however, heavy congestion was reported at several places along the vital arterial road, causing inconvenience to commuters. Traffic officials said that despite the highway being operational for both sides, traffic jams were witnessed at multiple stretches due to high vehicle volume and frequent overtaking by motorists. item.title: MeT predicts Snowfall, Rain in Jammu Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: The Meteorological Department Srinagar on Saturday issued a detailed forecast, warning of a fresh wet spell likely to impact the Union Territory over the coming days. item.title: Jammu Kashmir: 45-year-old Woman found tied in Plastic Bag, critical
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 19: A shocking incident came to light in Rajouri district of Jammu and Kashmir late Sunday after a 45-year-old woman was found tied with a rope inside a plastic bag in an isolated area, triggering alarm among locals and prompting immediate police action. According to police officials, the woman has been identified as Azeem Akhtar. She was discovered inside the bag along a deserted stretch in the Tandwal area of the district.
